title: Calcium state prediction beyond population rate and acquisition context
question: Does population calcium organization help predict independently annotated state in an unseen animal beyond population activity and acquisition-context information?
scope: One prospective task across both natural sleep and anesthesia. It is not exact reproduction of the paper's modularity figures, raw-movie processing, anatomical connectivity, or a consciousness mechanism test.

source_facts.schema_conflict: The demo and analysis loader name different metadata variables. Authentic reconciliation is required; neither dictionary is presumed authoritative for all files.
source_facts.indexing: The demo describes boundary_ind(k)=9500 as a cut between MATLAB frames9500 and9501. Convert this to zero-based half-open cut9500 only after actual field authentication. Do not subtract1 from the cut value.
source_facts.used_frame: The official selected-frame lists select awake versus NREM/anesthesia for network analysis. This prospective all-state classifier must not treat those selected frames as a complete cohort or discard quiet-wake/REM silently.

protected_input_contract.all_release_members: Acquire and checksum the entire processed archive once; inventory all original members, all animal/session identities, all neurons, all frame labels and every acquisition boundary. No sample/prefix can qualify the complete source.
protected_input_contract.no_movies: No raw TIFF reconstruction is selected. The1.32TiB raw collection is not needed if complete processed signal/annotation equivalence is established.
protected_input_contract.version: Reconcile the2025 Zenodo processed record against the2026 RIKEN/SSBD version3 collection; a link or matching title alone is not equivalence.
protected_input_contract.animal_identity: Require explicit source-backed animal-to-recording joins. Never derive mouse IDs from file names, cell indexes or arbitrary blocks.
protected_input_contract.signals: Use a completely inventoried neuron-by-frame field with independently authenticated sampling rate, units, orientation and preprocessing context. Do not hand label fields, used_frame selections, state-specific paths, absolute acquisition order or outcome-bearing filenames to participants.
protected_input_contract.manifest_ownership: The evaluator owns the digest-bound manifest. Its admission evidence digests refer to real reviewed evidence; Boolean flags cannot establish scientific admission. No authentic manifest is supplied with this source package.
protected_input_contract.case_identity: Case IDs are HMAC-SHA256 of canonicalprivate task/recording/animal/source/frame coordinates under an evaluator-only cryptographically random256-bit salt, sealed in the digest-bound private manifest. Salt and privatecoordinates must never be mounted to a participant. candidate_index projects onlycase_id, permittedregime,n_frames and sorts byopaque token rather than acquisition time. The validator checks keyformat, not entropy; trustedintake generates the salt withsecrets.token_hex(32).

split.outer: Complete leave-one-animal-out evaluation, each authenticated animal tested exactly once. All its sessions remain together.
split.inner: One or more disjoint validation animals selected in a frozen rotation; remaining animals train. At least3 animals required. Hyperparameters, feature scaling, cell/region handling and any learned transform fit without test animals.
split.coverage_gate: Every outer training and validation pool must contain all six regime/state combinations. Missing support blocks this declared task; it does not authorize class removal or within-recording substitution.
split.windowing: Freeze integer window_frames after authentic sampling-rate review. Split every complete state epoch at every acquisition discontinuity, guard each segment at both ends by the complete preprocessing/context radius, then enumerate all complete nonoverlapping windows from its start. Account explicitly for every guarded and remainder frame. No window crosses a state or acquisition boundary.
split.guard: guard_frames must cover the authenticated smoothing/filter impulse support and any feature context. If this cannot be bounded, processed features are inadmissible for this split. The supplied source permits0 only with true zero-context evidence.
split.test_missing_classes: Preserve per-animal/regime state coverage in outputs; average recalls only over states actually present in that animal/regime. Training and validation still require complete global support. No interpretation as uniform global-class accuracy when test coverage differs.

metrics.primary: Within each animal/regime, compute recall separately for each present state and average states; average regimes within animal; average animals. This is animal-macro balanced accuracy.
metrics.secondary: The same hierarchy applied to negative log2 probability, clipping only at1e-12 for log computation. Report every state/regime/animal result and complete frame conservation.
metrics.comparison: Paired per-animal differences against an evaluator-owned training-selected global-activity reference, with identical cases. primary_gain is the macro balanced-accuracy difference. No significance claim is produced by this scorer.
metrics.uncertainty: Before authentic candidate execution, select a group-level interval/test appropriate to the final animal count and fix multiplicity for the two regimen contrasts. Cells and windows are not inferential replicates. This unresolved plan blocks qualification, not source construction.
metrics.refusals: Unknown labels, class collisions, missing/extra/duplicate predictions, unsupported probabilities, animal leakage, missing folds, epoch gaps, unsorted/duplicate/out-of-range cuts, unadmitted source evidence, and nonfinite values are rejected.

competent_references.name: global_activity
competent_references.plan: For each complete window compute population mean, standard deviation, active-cell fraction and temporal power summaries in prespecified physical-frequency bands. Fit train-standardized regularized multinomial logistic regression; choose regularization using the held validation animals. Sampling-rate-dependent bands and active thresholds must be bound after authentic units review.

competent_references.name: network_plus_activity
competent_references.plan: Add population correlation-distribution and independently implemented spatial-distance-conditioned summaries to the same reference; compare with global_activity under identical training/validation/test groups. Region/coordinate aggregation must be train-bound and handle unseen neuronal identities without test fitting. FullN-by-N correlation storage is not assumed feasible; use exact streamed sufficient statistics if the complete scope is preserved.

competent_references.name: metadata_nuisance
competent_references.plan: Use only permitted acquisition/regimen metadata, duration and missingness summaries; remove direct state/filename information. Score it on identical groups to detect recording or acquisition confounding. Failure to authenticate animal/condition overlap is a hold, not a reason to call the calcium model neural understanding.

competent_references.name: structure_destruction
competent_references.plan: Apply a frozen per-neuron circular shift inside eligible contiguous segments with shifts exceeding the complete feature context; compare identically tuned references. Never shift across discontinuities or claim destroyed all temporal information. This control is proposed, unimplemented and unrun.

two_modes.fixed_program: Same complete training labels, public paper/specification and allowed tools as interactive. Commit a reusable program before evaluation animal data are mounted. The program emits probabilities for every required case without target feedback.
two_modes.interactive: Same cases, public context and permitted model/reference tools; investigate each evaluation animal within an equal total compute and tool budget. Commit all probabilities before private scoring. No case-level score feedback or protected labels.
two_modes.information_arms: Primary comparison varies workflow only. A separate official-code arm is held until code permissions are established; public availability is not a redistribution license. This package copies no official code.
two_modes.resources: No authentic compute operation is selected. Both arms require an identical concrete resource selection after full schema/size census and baseline profiling; no unbounded interactive compute or arbitrary candidate-only preprocessing allowance.

open_holds: No authentic processed archive was read; complete cohort, neurons, frames and native schema remain unknown.
Unknown animal identities and full cross-animal state support; proposed complete split may prove infeasible.
Processed release equivalence, independent EEG/EMG label joins and filtering context are unverified.
Code license is not established; do not redistribute official implementation.
References, authentic protected execution, suitable animal-level uncertainty and resource calibration remain unrun.
contamination: Data and labels are public and may be pretraining-exposed. Runtime isolation cannot undo exposure. No SOTA, native-LLM signal understanding, causal or consciousness conclusion follows from a score alone.

candidate_signal_packet.implementation_status: Only metadata whitelist projection is implemented; actualsignal extraction/packaging and containment remain unimplemented admission gates.
candidate_signal_packet.signal: A complete per-window neuron-by-relative-frame matrix from one frozen authentic field (dFF, spike or another explicitly admitted representation), with original physicalunits and all eligible neurons; declared samplingrate and relativewindowtime, neverabsolute frame oracquisitiontime. The fieldchoice and all preprocessing are shared acrossmodes.
candidate_signal_packet.delivery_order: Opaque-token order. The protectedrunner creates a freshscope for eachouterfold and exposes onlyits training/validationlabels; evaluator targetlabels,manifest and sourceidentity maps remain separate.
candidate_signal_packet.nuisance_comparator: Explicitregime,neuroncount,allowedcoordinate distributions and permittedacquisitionmetadata mustalso be available to the matchedmetadata-onlybaseline. The regime is an allowedknown context, not evidence extracted fromcalcium.
